title: Comparative immobilization of labile Pb and Zn fractions in contaminated soil using jackfruit seed-, sugarcane bagasse-, and taro stem-derived biochars: a machine learning-assisted mechanistic elucidation
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,23554-23584
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01444E, Paper

Truong Xuan Vuong, Ha Ngan Nguyen, The Chinh Pham, Thi Thao Truong, Thi Tam Khieu, Thanh Phuong Phan, Thi Thu Ha Pham, Thi Thu Thuy Nguyen, Xuan Thang Dam
Lead (Pb) and zinc (Zn) persist in mining-affected soils due to their association with labile fractions that control mobility and potential bioavailability, necessitating fraction-resolved approaches to evaluate stabilization processes.
